SELECT sq_leave_cycle.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO leave_cycle (leave_cycle_id, company_id, employee_id, starts_on, ends_on, career_months, granted_days) VALUES (#{leaveCycleId}, #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, TO_DATE(#{startsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 0, #{grantedDays})
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(delta_days), 0) FROM leave_ledger WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND leave_cycle_id = #{leaveCycleId} AND change_type = 'LC_GRANT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_ledger (company_id, leave_cycle_id, leave_request_day_id, change_type, delta_days, actor_account_id, note) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{leaveCycleId}, NULL, 'LC_GRANT', #{deltaDays}, #{actorAccountId}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT l.leave_ledger_id, l.delta_days, l.note, TO_CHAR(l.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, e.employee_name AS actor_name FROM leave_ledger l JOIN leave_cycle c ON c.leave_cycle_id = l.leave_cycle_id AND c.company_id = l.company_id LEFT JOIN user_account a ON a.user_account_id = l.actor_account_id AND a.company_id = l.company_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = a.employee_id AND e.company_id = a.company_id WHERE l.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND l.change_type = 'LC_GRANT' ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.leave_ledger_id DESC

SELECT c.leave_cycle_id, c.company_id, c.employee_id, TO_CHAR(c.starts_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS starts_on, TO_CHAR(c.ends_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ends_on, c.granted_days, (SELECT NVL(SUM(l.delta_days), 0) FROM leave_ledger l WHERE l.company_id = c.company_id AND l.leave_cycle_id = c.leave_cycle_id) AS ledger_days FROM leave_cycle c JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = c.employee_id AND e.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.starts_on <= e.hire_date AND c.ends_on > e.hire_date
SELECT employee_id, leave_date, slot_code, leave_request_day_id FROM leave_slot WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND leave_date IN TO_DATE(#{d}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_slot (company_id, employee_id, leave_date, slot_code, leave_request_day_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{leaveDate}, #{slotCode}, #{leaveRequestDayId})

INSERT INTO leave_ledger (company_id, leave_cycle_id, leave_request_day_id, change_type, delta_days, actor_account_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{leaveCycleId}, #{leaveRequestDayId}, 'LC_USE', #{deltaDays}, #{actorAccountId})
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(d.deduct_days), 0) FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND d.leave_date >= TO_DATE(#{startsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND d.leave_date < TO_DATE(#{endsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT ad.approval_document_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.leave_type) = 1 THEN MAX(d.leave_type) ELSE 'LV_FULL' END AS leave_type, TO_CHAR(MIN(d.leave_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS from_date, TO_CHAR(MAX(d.leave_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS to_date, lr.requested_days AS days, lr.reason, TO_CHAR(ad.submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS submitted_at, ad.status_code FROM approval_document ad JOIN leave_request lr ON lr.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND lr.company_id = ad.company_id JOIN leave_request_day d ON d.approval_document_id = ad.approval_document_id AND d.company_id = ad.company_id WHERE ad.company_id = #{companyId} AND ad.author_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ad.document_type = 'DOC_LEAVE' AND ad.status_code IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') GROUP BY ad.approval_document_id, lr.requested_days, lr.reason, ad.submitted_at, ad.status_code HAVING MAX(d.leave_date) >= TO_DATE(#{startsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND MIN(d.leave_date) < TO_DATE(#{endsOn}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY MIN(d.leave_date) DESC

SELECT s.approval_document_id, s.step_no, e.employee_name AS approver_name, s.status_code, s.opinion FROM approval_step s JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = s.approver_employee_id AND e.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.company_id = #{companyId} AND s.approval_document_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.approval_document_id, s.step_no
